verses.verse:
निर्माणे या विधिस्तासाम् नादशास्त्रेण सम्मता।
लिख्यते साररूपेण लघुबुद्धया विविच्य च।।१०।।
verses.text: The method of making them that is approved by the science of sound (nāda-śāstra) is written here in essence, after reflection, with [my] small understanding.

commentary.text: The method of making them that accords with the śāstra I am writing down after reflecting on it with my small understanding. Perhaps this process of making will be useful to our flute-playing brothers.

subsection.title: The Kinds of Flute and Suitable Materials
